attchmntText: Jindal Photo Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Jindal Photo Limited published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, as approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 15, 2026. Evonile Pharma Limited filed a Letter of Offer dated November 4, 2026, for a rights issue. The record date for the rights entitlement was November 14, 2026. The rights equity shares are listed on BSE under symbol EVONILE. ABC Industries India Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange platforms. Belrise Industries Limited also released its financial results for the relevant periods.

Jindal Photo Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board reported a profit before tax of 914 Lakhs for the quarter and 1,594 Lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share stood at 6.34 for the quarter and 12.84 for the half year. The company recognized a fair valuation gain of 1,078 Lakhs on investments in Jindal India Power Ltd. Regarding its voluntary delisting, the discovered price was set at Rs 1,161 per equity share. Consideration was paid to public shareholders on November 13, 2026. The Board also extended the redemption tenure of redeemable preference shares to 2031 and waived interest on loans to Mandakini Coal Company Limited.

attchmntText: Intimation regarding publication of Post Offer Public Announcement ( Post Offer PA ) announcing the successful completion of the Delisting Offer of equity shares of Jindal Photo Limited from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to the SEBI (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021 ( Delisting Regulations )
voiceSummary: Jindal Photo Limited intimates the publication of the Post Offer Public Announcement on November 10, 2026, confirming the successful completion of its voluntary delisting offer from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The reverse book building process was conducted from November 02, 2026, to November 06, 2026. The outcome was announced on November 06, 2026, by Saffron Capital Advisors Private Limited. The Post Offer Public Announcement, dated November 09, 2026, was published in Financial Express, Jansatta, and Pratahkal newspapers. The intimation is also available on the company website.

attchmntText: Submission of Recommendations of the Committee of Independent Directors ( IDC ) under Regulation 28 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Delisting of Equity Shares) Regulations, 2021, as amended ( SEBI Delisting Regulations ) for the delisting of the Equity Shares of Jindal Photo Limited ( Company )
